EXERCISE: Heating and cooling degree days
Explain what these are: a form of accumulation. In the data section, get some data on hourly temperatures over the years and accumulate these into heating degree days. 

```{webr}
#| min-lines: 3
daily_temperatures <- c(45, 51, 67, 72, 74, 85)
pmax(0, 55 - daily_temperatures)
pmax(0, daily_temperatures - 65)
```

:::
